headline: Avery Dennison Q2 Earnings Call Highlights
summary: Avery Dennison (NYSE:AVY) reported second-quarter results marked by accelerating organic growth, higher margins and strong free cash flow, while reinstating full-year guidance despite expected customer inventory destocking in its Materials Group during the second half.
